verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents running headlessly in automation in several ways: connecting GitHub-hosted runners through ephemeral, authenticated connections; ephemeral nodes built for containers and CI/CD; Docker containers and Kubernetes sidecars; cloud-init first-boot installs; and an official CLI. A community user also confirms routing a GitHub Actions worker through Tailscale successfully. One user reports that API keys expire after 60 days and need manual login to renew, which adds friction for long-running automation. Missing for 10: detailed evidence on non-interactive authentication (auth keys or OAuth clients) for CI, in-depth documentation rather than one-line summaries, and a solution to the API-key expiry friction.
